art_direction: 野蔷薇穿整齐的棕色短外套与长裤，坐在城市街角长椅上，旁边放着纸袋。
composition_variation: Create a fashionable but age-appropriate anime illustration of Nobara Kugisaki resting on a city bench after shopping. Preserve her short auburn bob, side-swept fringe, brown eyes, and spirited confident smile. Dress her in a fully covering caramel jacket, cream shirt, tailored dark trousers, and loafers. One hand rests on the bench while the other adjusts a small shoulder-bag strap. Place one plain shopping bag by her feet. Use terracotta paving, sage storefront shapes, golden late afternoon light, and quiet upper architecture. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved in Codex local artifact directory anime-wallpapers-100/native. Final wallpaper is cropped and resized, not generated natively at final dimensions.
